# Controller 1.0.24
- Controller now speaks British English, Spanish, German, French, Japanese, Brazilian Portuguese and Simplified Chinese. - Dictation learns each project's names, files and terms, so words like ThreadStore, AGENTS.md and your models' names come out spelled right. - Dictation cleanup weighs the words the recognizer was unsure of and common developer mix-ups such as cache for cash, and learns from the words you correct before sending. - Each project gets a short on-device summary that dictation cleanup and chat titles use, without spending any account's tokens. - A long model name stacks above its effort in the composer, and the composer controls stay on one row.

Controller 1.0.23
- Embedded Chromium browsing keeps pages and popups inside Controller. - Login cookies and browser sessions persist across restarts. - Website passkey requests can offer a phone QR code or security key. - Improved browser navigation, restored tab history and embedded-page compatibility. - Updated OpenCode 2 integration and native agent handling.

# Controller 1.0.22
- Group copies of the same project across Macs, edit their shared settings together, and choose how checkouts are grouped. Filter and start chats across your Macs from one project. - Add native Pi support, including streaming, model and thinking controls, extension dialogs, and subagent activity. - Restore Droid token usage and model-specific reasoning controls, including Auto and Off settings. - Support newer OpenCode session and permission events, and show Antigravity subagent details. - Keep Codex questions with options answerable after another message is sent, and preserve completion badges after chats are read. - Preserve spaces and paragraph breaks in streamed reasoning, improve reconnection when a Mac changes address, and suppress foreground push alerts.
